Title: Icarus I - Abstract Cave Relief
Description:
Abstract marks and a textured surface give Icarus the feeling of an ancient story retold in a contemporary relief. The composition invites a closer look, with small details revealing themselves as light moves across it.

A striking focal point for an open wall, bringing the atmosphere of a found fragment into an interior or outdoor setting.

  • Dimensions: Panel 200 × 100 × 5 cm; support framework 186 × 86 × 6.5 cm; face thickness 15 mm
  • Weight: Approximately 60 kg
  • Use: Suitable for outdoor use and indoor display.
  • Fixings: Keyhole fixings are usually used. Other options, including French cleats, are available; the fixing choice can be agreed for your sculpture and wall.
  • Availability: Made to order
  • Production lead time: 1-2 weeks
  • Delivery: Delivery is quoted separately. Please contact us for UK and international delivery options.
